title: Finding a book in the library
checked: Every reachable state checked (6 states, 8 with their data, 14 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 6 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
Zoom in and zoom out move the view one box at a time. The view never skips from the book to the floor or the building.
rules.path: Take away the looking at the floor guard and it breaks in 3 steps: zoom in, zoom in, zoom out.

rules.says: The book is lent only when it is on the shelf, never while it is out already.
rules.path: Take away the on the shelf guard and it breaks in 5 steps: zoom in, zoom in, zoom in, borrow it, borrow it.

rules.rule: Only a lent book comes back
rules.says: Bring it back works only when the book is out.
rules.path: Take away the lent out guard and it breaks in 4 steps: zoom in, zoom in, zoom in, bring it back.
